chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Yūnus, from a man, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, that he said:
For grazing livestock, its owners are not liable for anything.

key_terms.الْأَنْعَامِ: livestock animals such as camels, cattle, and sheep
key_terms.لَا يَغْرَمُ: does not incur liability or compensation

ai.seo_question: Are the owners of grazing livestock liable for damages in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning liability for damage associated with livestock. It indicates that, in this stated case, the owners of grazing animals are not held financially responsible.
